name: InterseXtions: Gender and Sexuality
what_you_do: Explore gender and sexuality in art with other teens. You make art, talk about representation, and plan a free, large event for LGBTQ+ teens and allies.
pay_detail: $17 per hour. Second-year members are leaders and earn $18 per hour. Up to 75 hours for the year. OMNY cards for weekend and evening work.
duration: November 2026 to June 2027: Tuesdays 4:30 to 6:30 PM, plus some Fridays and weekends.
deadline_text: Applications closed Oct 18, 2026. Next dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Online application through the link on the program page when it is open.
notes: Open to queer and trans youth and allies. You must commit to the full schedule. Questions: teen.programs@brooklynmuseum.org.
